body.p: Git worktrees let you checkout multiple branches of a repository simultaneously, each in its own separate working directory. Instead of constantly switching branches and stashing changes, you can have different branches active at the same time.

You can open a worktree in the Git Staging view and work with it like you would with a standard working copy. The Git Client add-on supports existing worktrees, but you cannot create new ones directly from the user interface. To create a new worktree, use the terminal instead.
